title: Pearl is Moon
description:
A texture pack for 1.21+ that turns the moon into PearlescentMoon.

It'll probably work on earlier versions, you'll just have to bully MC into it.
body: This is just a silly thing I made that turns the moon into PearlescentMoon's face lol. It should work on 1.21+, if it's broken uh- try and force minecraft into making it work anyways. :D
